title: Dr. Richard Rothman Weight Loss Doctor Fairfax VA - Belite Medical Center
abstract:
Dr. Rothman has published over 400 scientific papers on on[weight loss supplements](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/?term=rothman%20rb%20AND%20Phentermine) and [other medical topics](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/?term=rothman%20RB) in peer-reviewed journals and has presented over 400 scientific abstracts at national and international meetings. His published work on appetite suppressants has established him as a leading expert in this field. Notably, Dr. Rothman’s laboratory was among the first to identify the mechanism responsible for [valvular heart disease produced by fenfluramine](https://circ.ahajournals.org/content/102/23/2836.long).. In collaboration with Dr. Ed Hendricks, he has contributed several published papers reviewing the [overall safety of phentermine](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/?term=rothman%20rb%20AND%20Hendricks)..  
Dr. Rothman has received numerous awards recognizing his work, including the Joseph Cochin Young Investigator Award from the Committee on Problems of Drug Dependence (1991), the Scientific Achievement Award in Biological Sciences for contributions in opioid pharmacology from the Washington Academy of Sciences (1989), and the A. E. Bennett Award (Basic Science) from the Society for Biological Psychiatry (1987).
